title: Initiative storyboard: integrate SLO runway with on-call and roadmap prioritization
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Teams lack a clear, operational connection between SLO runway charts, scheduled initiative work, and on-call remediation flows. That gap makes it hard to (a) prioritize reliability work on the roadmap driven by error-budget runway, (b) automate escalation and rollback decisions, and (c) give on-call engineers actionable runbooks tied to initiatives.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated initiative storyboard view that maps SLO runway slices to active/pending initiatives and on-call playbooks
Automated tagging of initiatives when error-budget runway drops below configured thresholds (e.g., 30d/14d/7d)
On-call runbooks surfaced in the Console linked to initiative pages with one-click playbook execution links
Routing policy: initiatives flagged "high-priority" automatically create a follow-up ticket for Dedicated/Runtime teams when error-budget is exhausted
Telemetry: change in SLI burn + initiative start/stop timestamps are tracked and visible in the initiative timeline
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Kumar: Drafted ticket after PM sync with SRE and Oncall leads. Goal: reduce time-to-priority for reliability initiatives and make escalation less ad-hoc.

2026-03-11 - Liam O'Connor: Scoped MVE: storyboard page in Console + basic tagging automation + on-call runbook links. Proposed estimate 5 pts. Blockers: API to write initiative tags from telemetry (ENG owner needed).

2026-03-11 - Priya Desai (SRE): +1 to MVE. Suggested thresholds: 30d for monitoring, 14d create a canary initiative, 7d auto-escalate. Also called out requirement to avoid noisy tagging for short-lived experiments.

2026-03-12 - Design review (Marco Ortega): Shared low-fidelity mockups in PR. Feedback: use color-blind-safe palette for runway slices and include an affordance to expand runbook steps inline. Action: design will provide hi-fi by 2026-03-18.

2026-03-12 - ENG triage (Keisha Liu): Noted dependency on ENG-1842 (telemetry event schema) and requested a small API contract doc. Assigned follow-up to runtime telemetry owner. Potential implementation approaches discussed: push-based tagging vs. pull-based cron job. Trade-off: push scales better, but requires more telemetry points.

2026-03-12 - Product note: Keep UI actions idempotent. Any automated escalation must create a draft initiative (not immediately triaged to avoid noisy assignments) unless error-budget is in critical state (configurable).
next_steps: Finalize API contract for initiative tagging by 2026-03-17 (owner: Keisha)
Design hi-fi storyboard and runbook inline UX by 2026-03-18 (owner: Marco)
Build prototype: console storyboard page + tagging webhook consumer (ENG) — spike start 2026-03-20
Define rollout policy: opt-in per-org and default thresholds in Admin settings
Schedule cross-functional review with SRE, Runtime, and Console on 2026-03-24
notes_for_engineering: Telemetry events required: sli.burn_rate, error_budget_days_left, initiative.linked_start/stop
Recommended implementation: event-driven tagging microservice with idempotent writes to initiative metadata
Consider rate-limiting logic to prevent oscillation when runway hovers around thresholds
Persist audit trail for automated actions for post-incident review
